name: Pushups
description: Push-ups are a bodyweight exercise that builds upper-body and core strength by working the chest, shoulders, and triceps.
instruction:
Starting position:
- Get on all fours, then extend your legs back so your body forms a straight line from your head to your heels. Place your hands on the floor slightly wider than your shoulders, with your fingers spread. 
Engage your core:
- Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to keep your hips from sagging or arching your back. Keep your gaze on the floor in front of you to maintain a neutral neck position. 
Lowering your body:
- Bend your elbows, keeping them tucked in towards your sides at about a 45-degree angle, and lower your chest towards the floor. Go down until your chest is almost touching the ground. 
Pressing back up:
- Push through your hands to extend your arms and return to the high plank position. Pause briefly before starting the next repetition.
